simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to הֲרָרִי (H2043) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: a n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: הֲרָרִי (Hărârîy) means Hararite. First listed occurrence: 1Chr 11 34.

definitions.full: H2043. Harari הָארָרִי 2Sam 23:33 b see הֲרָרִי . הַב see יהב . הַבְהָבִים see below יהב . הָרָרִי הֲרָרִי, adjective, of a people (= mountain-dweller (Thes) ? or derived from some unknown proper name, of a location ); — used only in defining certain of David's heroes: 1. a. הַהֲרָרִי שַׁמָּה 2Sam 23:33 a (compare Dr) = 1Chr 11:34 b (where read probably שַׁמָּה for ᵐ5 שָׁגֵה, L Σαμαια ). b. הָרָרִי בֶּןאָֿגֵא שַׁמָּה 2Sam 23:11 (read perhaps הַהֲרָרִי compare Dr; but ᵐ5 ὁ Ἀρουχαῖος , ᵐ5 L ὁ Αραχι , i.e. הָאַרְכִּי ? Klo). On הַהֲרוֺרִי שַׁמּוֺת 1Chr 11:27 ( ᵐ5 ὁ Ἁδι , ᵐ5 L ὁ Αρωρι ) see הֲרוֺרִי above. 2 הָארָרִי בֶּןשָֿׁרָר אֲחִיאָם 2Sam 23:33 b (read probably הַהֲרָרִי ) = הַהֲרָרִי בֶּןשָֿׂכָר אֲחִיאָם 1Chr 11:35 .
definitions.rootNote: or הָרָרִי ; (2 Samuel 23:11), or הָארָרִי ; (2 Samuel 23:34, last clause), apparently from 2042 ; a mountaineer
